display.purpose: The group name, hand-lettered directly on the board — the only 40px PermanentMarker text in the product.

title.purpose: Section headers on every paper card, always PermanentMarker in marker-red.

label.purpose: Eyebrows, column headers, badges, timestamps — system sans, never marker.

body.purpose: Default UI text — names, picks, chat, CTA subtext.

shadows.name: card-lift
shadows.purpose: Standings and Power Rankings — the two surfaces worth the most craft on the page.

shadows.name: cta-lift
shadows.purpose: The two hero NFL/CFB pick CTA buttons — the strongest shadow on the page.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Pill-shaped primary action (Refresh scores, Share invite) — Turf Teal survives from the prior world unchanged, deliberately not re-skinned in marker-red.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #0B735F; color: #FFFFFF; padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 999px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; border: none; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #085041; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #085041; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Paper Card
components.description: The standard chalk-paper sheet used for every section — dashed border, slight rotation, tape-corner accent, PermanentMarker title in marker-red.
components.css: .ds-card { position: relative; background: #F5F3E7; border: 1.5px dashed rgba(12,23,18,0.18); border-radius: 10px; padding: 12px; padding-top: 16px; transform: rotate(-0.6deg); } .ds-tape { position: absolute; top: -8px; left: 16px; width: 46px; height: 18px; background: rgba(244,196,48,0.55); border: 1px solid rgba(180,140,20,0.35); transform: rotate(-3deg); } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Permanent Marker', cursive; font-size: 20px; color: #B23A2E; }

components.name: Rank Circle (First Place)
components.description: The #1 spot in Power Rankings — a marker-red circle outline, transparent fill, slight tilt. Replaced a filled dark pill from the prior world; the product's 'coach circled your name on the board' signature moment.
components.css: .ds-rank-first { display: inline-block; background: transparent; color: #B23A2E; border: 2px solid #B23A2E; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; padding: 2px 8px; transform: rotate(-4deg); }

components.name: Rank Badge (Other)
components.description: Any rank below #1 in Power Rankings — a plain dark filled pill, unchanged from the prior world.
components.css: .ds-rank-badge { background: #0C1712; color: #FFFFFF; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; border-radius: 999px; padding: 1px 6px; }

components.name: Lock Icon
components.description: Authored SVG padlock replacing the prior 🔒 emoji — thick rounded marker-style stroke, unfilled. Appears beside the board eyebrow and the Weekly Locks section title.

components.name: Pick Cell — Win
components.description: A decided-win cell in the Weekly Locks grid — internal grid colors kept from the prior world so the spreadsheet stays legible.

components.name: Hero CTA
components.description: The two big NFL/CFB pick entry-point buttons — now chalk-paper with a dashed border and the strongest shadow on the page, instead of a plain white card.
components.css: .ds-hero-cta { background: #F5F3E7; border: 1.5px dashed rgba(12,23,18,0.15); border-radius: 16px; padding: 18px 16px; box-shadow: 0 5px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.28); display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 6px; } .ds-hero-cta:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-hero-cta-title { font-weight: 800; font-size: 17px; color: #0C1712; } .ds-hero-cta-sub { font-weight: 600; font-size: 12px; color: #45564C; }

narrative.overview: WeekendLocks is a locker-room whiteboard, not a dashboard. This replaces the product's prior visual world (Turf Teal + slate + white cards) entirely. A dark chalkboard-green board (#063D31) fills the screen and is the header itself — the group name is hand-lettered directly onto it in large chalk-white PermanentMarker type beside a drawn padlock icon. Every section below reads as a sheet of paper taped to that board: chalk-paper fill, dashed hand-drawn outline, a masking-tape corner accent, and a few degrees of rotation per card. The tone stays loud and personal, but the loudness now comes from material — chalk, marker, tape, paper — instead of a generic dark-mode sports-app template.
keyCharacteristics: One board for every group: per-group hash-colored hero backgrounds were removed; identity now lives in the hand-lettered name and member avatar chips only.
Paper-pinned-to-board is the universal card language — dashed border, slight rotation, and a shared TapeCorner component, never hand-rolled per file.
PermanentMarker is reserved for exactly two roles: the group name and section titles — never buttons, data, or body text.
The lock symbol is now a drawn SVG (LockIcon), replacing the 🔒 emoji, per the product's standing requirement to keep a lock symbol somewhere concrete.
The #1 spot in Power Rankings is circled in marker (transparent, red ring, tilted) instead of a filled badge.
Only Standings and Power Rankings carry real shadow lift; Recent Activity and Chat stay flat.

rules.name: The Same Hash, Different Canvas Rule (narrowed)
rules.body: The six identity color pairs still power member avatars, but no longer extend to group hero backgrounds — every group now shares one board. Never hand-pick an identity color or add a seventh.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: PermanentMarker is reserved for exactly two roles — the group name and section titles. It never appears on a button, a data value, or body copy.

rules.name: The Dashed-and-Tilted Rule
rules.body: Every paper card uses a dashed border and a small fixed rotation instead of a solid hairline and square alignment, so the board reads as hand-assembled.

rules.name: The Two-Tier Lift Rule
rules.body: Not every paper sheet gets the same shadow. Only Standings, Power Rankings, and the two hero CTAs earn real shadow lift; everything else stays flat.

dos: Do route every card through the shared card/cardElevated style plus a TapeCorner — never hand-roll a dashed border or tape rectangle inline.
Do keep PermanentMarker confined to the group name and section titles.
Do keep the LockIcon as the product's lock symbol going forward rather than reintroducing the emoji.
Do give a card real shadow only when it's a genuinely high-value surface.
donts: Don't reintroduce per-group hash-colored hero backgrounds.
Don't use opacity to indicate a disabled state on a chalk-paper surface — it blends into the board behind it.
Don't add a seventh member-identity color or reorder the existing six.
Don't apply the paper-card language to the Danger Zone — it stays a plain red alert box.
